title: Console backend: experiment CRUD endpoints + lifecycle actions (start/stop/rollback) w/ audit logs
author: Chloe Martin
description: Implements the Console backend APIs for route-level A/B experiment management, including CRUD operations, server-side validation, lifecycle actions (start/stop/rollback), and structured audit log emission for all mutating actions. This PR adds the first public-facing control-plane surface area used by Console to configure experiments; it does not include results queries/aggregation (handled in ENG-2844/ENG-2841 follow-ups). API summary: GET /v1/console/projects/{project_id}/experiments (list, filtered by route + status), POST /v1/console/projects/{project_id}/experiments (create draft), GET /v1/console/projects/{project_id}/experiments/{experiment_id} (read), PATCH /v1/console/projects/{project_id}/experiments/{experiment_id} (update draft metadata/config), DELETE /v1/console/projects/{project_id}/experiments/{experiment_id} (delete draft only), POST /v1/console/projects/{project_id}/experiments/{experiment_id}:validate (returns warnings/errors without mutation), POST /v1/console/projects/{project_id}/experiments/{experiment_id}:start, POST /v1/console/projects/{project_id}/experiments/{experiment_id}:stop, POST /v1/console/projects/{project_id}/experiments/{experiment_id}:rollback. Validation rules (v1): traffic allocation must sum to 100% with per-variant min/max bounds; route selector must be a single concrete route (no wildcards) and must match an existing gateway route in project; variants must reference a valid model deployment target (Hosted or Dedicated) and pin model version/config hash; disallow overlapping ACTIVE experiments on the same (project_id, route, region scope) tuple; schedule constraints: start_at <= stop_at, and scheduled start cannot be in the past (server time); safe defaults for stickiness_key are applied when omitted and a warning is returned if the request hashing inputs are insufficient for sticky assignment (e.g., missing api_key_id in auth context for certain auth modes). Authz/RBAC: only principals with console.experiments.write can create/update/start/stop/rollback; console.experiments.read for read/list/validate; all mutations require project-scoped access, and Dedicated targets additionally require dedicated.capacity.read to prevent leaking capacity pool identifiers. Audit logs: emits ab_experiment.created, ab_experiment.updated, ab_experiment.deleted, ab_experiment.started, ab_experiment.stopped, ab_experiment.rolled_back with actor metadata, project_id, experiment_id, previous_state/new_state, and a redacted config diff summary (no prompt text, no customer headers, no PII). Rollback semantics: rollback transitions ACTIVE->ROLLED_BACK and writes an immutable rollback_reason; it also writes a routing override record consumed by the policy engine so that traffic returns to control immediately (final wiring in ENG-2841). Notes: schema is versioned (config_schema_version=1) to allow evolution without breaking Console; added request/response examples to internal OpenAPI doc; includes unit tests for validation and state machine transitions and integration tests for audit emission. Risk/rollout: endpoints are behind the console_ab_experiments feature flag and will be enabled for internal dogfood only; no gateway behavior changes in this PR.
commits: console-api: add Experiment model + repository layer
console-api: CRUD endpoints for experiments + pagination/filtering
policy: add experiment lifecycle state machine + transition guards

tests: validation matrix + overlapping experiment constraints

changed_areas: Control-plane data model for experiment configs (minimal scaffolding)
conversation: Jada Williams: Can we clarify overlapping experiments rule—should it be per route only, or per route+region? Also, how do we handle canary rollouts already configured on the same route?

Chloe Martin (author): Updated validation to scope overlap checks to (project_id, route, region_scope). Canary precedence is handled in policy engine (ENG-2841); here we add a warning in :validate if a canary exists on the route so users understand expected behavior.

Marcus Lin: Audit log payloads look good, but the config diff includes variant 'target' identifiers—are any of those customer-provided strings that could contain PII? Please enforce allowlist + length caps.

Chloe Martin (author): Added allowlist for diff fields (route_id, model_id, model_version, traffic_percent, region_scope, schedule) and length caps; anything else is summarized as 'changed' without values. Added tests for redaction.
Ethan Park: For rollback, should we allow rollback from STOPPED as well? Some users may stop first then rollback.
Chloe Martin (author): Implemented rollback transitions from ACTIVE and STOPPED (STOPPED->ROLLED_BACK) but disallow from DRAFT. Added explicit error codes so Console can show actionable copy.

Naomi Feldman: Please add server-side validation that traffic allocation sums to 100 exactly, not within epsilon, since we represent as integers. Also ensure PATCH cannot mutate ACTIVE experiment config.

Chloe Martin (author): Done. traffic_percent is int; sum must equal 100. PATCH rejects config mutations unless state==DRAFT; only metadata fields (name/description) may be updated once ACTIVE. Added tests.
Dylan Brooks: Can we keep endpoints consistent with Console conventions—use :validate action instead of a separate /validate path and return warnings array for UI.
Chloe Martin (author): Adjusted to POST ...:validate and added warnings[] + errors[] structure. Console can block start on any errors.
release_notes: Internal only (feature-flagged): adds Console backend endpoints for managing route-level A/B experiments (create/update/validate/start/stop/rollback) with audit log events for lifecycle actions.
